Dana Lee: who is responsible for pods inventory? we are low on oat milk pods

Samir Patel: yep I'll reorder oat and decaf by EOD
Tom Brooks: victory

Miguel Alvarez: yes
Dana Lee: yes
Tom Brooks: yes
Samir Patel: yes if Samir gets admin access to the pod cabinet :joy:
CoffeeBot: reaction: :thumbsup:
